title: Chapter 287
text:
Blue Star ushered in a period of peace. Time flew by, and four months passed in the blink of an eye.

Sanctuary Three had been completely completed. There were tall protective walls, large filtration devices to purify the air and stabilize the temperature, and self-sufficient greenhouses and farms. The goal of the sanctuary was to protect humans in times of disaster and even preserve the fire of civilization. In these four months, Bennett had built more sanctuaries, but none of them could compare to the scale of Black Phantom's sanctuary.

Overmera and Lu Cheng moved the people over, built a satellite city around Sanctuary Three, and paid for the transportation network. Han Xiao's sanctuary could be said to be a big city.

[Sanctuary Plan – Sanctuary Three] completed. You have received 6,500,000 EXP and 1 Potential Point.

Performance Rating: A +

Dark Net Favorability increased by 2,500. Current Relationship: Reverence (6,000) – [Dark Net Leader]

A + Rating Reward: Additional 250% EXP (16,250,000), Special Item x1

You have received [Medal of Honor – Sanctuary Master (A)]

This construction-type main storyline mission's reward was mainly EXP, unlike the Germinal Organization's main storyline mission which had many special items. There were also no random rewards, and the NPC template did not have the right to create new dungeons. It was probably because it was a construction-type mission, so there were not many events.

Although the war had ended, there were still many areas in Blue Star that could be explored. Where there were people, there would be conflicts, and there would never be a lack of events. As the players explored deeper into Blue Star, the Six Nations, who were busy digesting the effects of the war and dealing with climate disasters, became more and more wary of the increasing number and strength of 'Inhumans'. However, overall, Blue Star's situation was stable. During this time, the main storyline and protagonists of the other novice planets began to shine, and the popularity of Blue Star cooled down.

Han Xiao stayed in the sanctuary and prepared to go into the galaxy. He did not cause any trouble, and the number of times he was mentioned as the main storyline protagonist gradually decreased. Most players would only remember the fear of being dominated by him when they were buying chests.

Just like what the Galaxy Times had said, when a main storyline ended, the corresponding protagonist would gradually fade into the crowd.

Han Xiao was not worried at all about the fading of his popularity. His deeds had been imprinted in the hearts of the players, and he had already laid a foundation. Even if it was temporarily replaced by other hot topics, once there was another big news, it would still awaken the players' feelings for him.

In these four months, he had collected a large amount of EXP, and there was a long string of zeros on his interface. Because of the rich interactions he had with the players, Han Technician had already established his identity as a 'Mechanic Instructor'. Many new players who had just joined the game would also come to spend money. This was a long-term benefit.

During this period of stability, Han Xiao lived a very comfortable life. However, he did not indulge in the pleasures of women … Bah, he did not indulge in pleasure and forget about his duties. He spent every day in the workshop building equipment and continued to train. He mastered the tactical system and maintained his peak condition.

He had used the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card and accurately predicted the opportunity to travel to the galaxy. There was still quite some time left. According to his memory, the S1 Pro League would start during this period. This was a grand event for the players. Han Xiao had been very concerned about this event in his previous life and wanted to join in the fun.

Furthermore, if his sanctuary could become the venue for the Pro League, it would bring in a lot of customers. The Pugilist and Esper class advancement knowledge, enhancement potions, high-level equipment, and so on that he had prepared would be able to make a lot of money.

Han Xiao spent a lot of effort to cultivate the four rookies, Mad Blade, Pork Bun, Beating Dog, Maple Moon, and Hao Tian, hoping that they could get a good result in the Pro League. This way, he would be honored as well. After all, most players knew that these four were the lucky ones who were cultivated by Black Phantom.

Galaxy Calendar Year 689, March 1st. On this day, an announcement was pinned at the top of the forum and marked red. Its popularity soared up the leaderboards at an unbelievable rate. This meant that the number of players who viewed and replied to the announcement was increasing by the minute!

In less than half an hour, it became the most popular post in the entire forum!

"Galaxy S1 Pro League officially established!"

"It's finally here."

Han Xiao was excited.

When the open beta had just started, there was news that the World Esports Association was going to host the Galaxy Pro League. After one and a half months in real life, there was finally official news!

"This morning, the World Esports Association announced that the first Galaxy Pro League will officially open. This will be the most authoritative and top-level competition. It will be a grand event that belongs to the players. This will be the biggest stage for all the experts to prove themselves. Show off your skills, and the world will cheer for you!

"The first Galaxy Pro League has a total of thirty-seven participating countries. China, Japan, Korea, North and South America, Eastern and Western Europe, Russia, and so on … According to the differences of the planets in the game, it will be divided into thirteen divisions. They are Planet Winterfrost Division, Planet Brighton Division, Planet Longsong Division, Planet Loney Division, and Blue Star Division …

"The rules of the first Galaxy Pro League are as follows: There are three types of competitions: Single Competition, Single Competition, and Team Competition.

Single Competition: Single Competition. Players will fight to determine the winner.

Single Competition: Team Competition. Players will take turns to fight, and the last player to stay in the ring will win.

Team Competition: Team Competition. Players will fight in a complicated environment. They will win after destroying all of their opponents or completing special missions.

First Division Qualifiers: All players will be accepted. The number of players in a team must be nine, including two substitutes, one coach, and six players. One battle elimination system. Teams will fight to determine the winner in the Team Competition (Note: Single players can only participate in the Single Competition). The top thirty-eight teams and the top sixty-two individuals will enter the Division Regular Competition.

Division Secondary League: Eighteen teams will be allowed to participate, and one hundred and twenty-eight individuals will be chosen. The points system will be used, and the winner and runner-up of the Team Competition and the Single Competition will be qualified for the Division Regular Competition. The top forty teams in the Regular Competition and the top sixty-four individuals will be chosen.

Pre-Season Competition: Players will warm up and take turns to fight. Winning or losing will not be counted.

Second Division Regular Competition: Points system. Teams will fight in the Single Competition and the Team Competition. The top eight teams in the Team Competition and the top sixteen in the Single Competition will enter the finals. If a team member enters the top sixteen in the Single Competition, the team will be awarded extra points. At the same time, the team and the individual first in the Team Competition will be invited to the International Exhibition Competition.

International Exhibition Competition (All-Star Competition): The top teams in the Division Regular Competition will compete with each other. Winning or losing will not be counted.

Third Division Final Competition: Fight in pairs, best of five. The Division Champion will be awarded the Division Trophy! The Division Champion, runner-up, and runner-up will enter the International Regular Competition!

Fourth Division International Regular Competition: Points system. Three strong teams from each division will fight in turns. The top eight teams in the Team Competition and the top sixteen individuals will enter the International Finals!

Final Division International Finals: Fight in pairs, best of five. The World Champion will be decided! "

"The venues for the Single Competition and the Single Competition are as follows: Winterfrost Planet: Crevice Canyon. Brighton Planet: Floating Island Academy … Blue Star: Black Phantom Sanctuary Three. "

"Registration for the Qualifiers and Secondary League will be held today. I hope the players will get the best results. S1 Galaxy Pro League is officially established! "

No matter which planet it was, the passion of all the players was boiling!

The entire world rejoiced in this grand occasion!

Seeing that Sanctuary Three was the venue for the Blue Star Competition, Han Xiao let out a long sigh of relief. Then, he became excited. It was as if he saw a tsunami of leeks gathering and drowning him.

The arena was too suitable for the Single Competition and the Single Competition. Plus, he had opened it to the players. With such a good venue, the chances of it becoming the venue were extremely high.

The Pro League was such a huge event being held in his territory. This was a huge business opportunity!

The competition format for the first Pro League is the same as I remember. Because it's the first Pro League, there are only three types of competitions. There will be more in the future, Han Xiao thought.

As expected, it's still the Qualifiers, Regular Competition, Division Final Competition, and International Finals. The first, second, and third place of the Division Final Competition and the first, second, second, and third place of the Finals all have very high bonuses. The big clubs are the main players of the first Pro League. Normal players can only achieve some results in the Single Competition.

It's actually easier to become famous and become a star player in the Single Competition. When some of the normal players show their strength, clubs will sign them, and they can become professional players in the next Pro League. Han Xiao nodded. He had experienced it personally. As a famous player in the Mechanic class, there were clubs that had sent him invitations, but he had rejected all of them. Everyone had their own ambitions. He did not like the tough training of a team. Playing games was more suitable for him.

Han Xiao touched his chin and thought to himself, If it's the first Pro League, I remember that China's results were average. North America or Europe won the championship. I think it was France or Canada?

At this time, he was living in a tall building in the middle of the Sanctuary. Looking down, the atmosphere of the players in the square had changed. They were excited, excited, expectant, and nervous.

"It's starting …"

Han Xiao also felt a little excited.
